atoms.text: This is Maxie the mouse. Maxie wants to teach you about human geography by showing you around some cities.

instruction.text: Answer Maxie’s question by listening to the options and selecting the correct answer.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'><prosody pitch = '+2st'>What is human geography?</prosody></voice>

b.sound: Human geography is the geography of anything natural, such as a beach or a lake!
Human geography is the geography of things built by humans, such as houses and roads.

instruction.text: Select the three images of cities.

feedback.finish: Correct! Cities usually have lots of tall buildings packed closely together. This is because so many people live there - often millions!
feedback.wrong: This is a village in the European countryside.

instruction.text: Maxie wants to show you some cities in the UK. This is London in England. Select the big bridge to learn more.

feedback.end: London is the biggest and most populated city in the UK. It is full of shops, restaurants, places to work and places to have fun.

instruction.text: This is York in England. Select the cathedral to learn more.

feedback.end: Not all cities are huge. The king or queen decides what counts as a city in the UK. Historically, cities had to have a cathedral!

instruction.text: Now we’re in Asia. This is Tokyo in Japan. Select the buildings to learn more.

feedback.end: Tokyo is the largest city in the world and is full of skyscrapers, which are very tall buildings. Many Asian cities are very large because they have so many people.

instruction.text: Maxie wants to know what you will normally find in cities. Select the three correct answers.

feedback.correct3: Some cities have so many buildings in them that there isn’t space for trains above ground - that’s why we have underground trains!

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Maxie wants to find out where the skyscrapers in London are. Answer Maxie’s question.

feedback.end: Correct! This is an aerial photograph of London - a photo taken from above. Aerial photographs give you a good view of the entire city, so you can see where all the skyscrapers are.

atoms.a: What can we use to see what a city looks like?
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'><prosody pitch = '+2st'>What can we use to see what a city looks like?</prosody></voice>

instruction.text: Now we’re on the streets of London! Select the image that shows skyscrapers.

feedback.finish: Great work! London has lots of skyscrapers because it has a large population. This means there are a lot of people living there - over 9 million!
